## Operational Cadence

### Every message
- Signal detection (spawn parallel): `skills/signal-detector/SKILL.md`
- Brain-first lookup: `skills/conventions/brain-first.md`

### Morning briefing (daily, ~7am local)
- Daily task prep: `skills/daily-task-prep/SKILL.md`
- Overdue items + today's meetings + focus call
- Calendar lookahead
- Open threads from yesterday

### Every 15 minutes
- Brain sync: `gbrain sync --no-pull && gbrain embed --stale`

### Daily
- Auto-update check: `gbrain check-update --json`
  - ⚠️ NEVER auto-apply updates. `~/.bun/bin/gbrain` must keep resolving to the fork at `~/github-repos/gbrain` (contains fork-only fix 81ee4ff4). A `bun install -g gbrain` or upstream update would silently revert the embedding-model fix. Verify: `readlink ~/.bun/bin/gbrain`.

### Weekly
- Brain health: `gbrain doctor --json`
- Embedding coverage: `gbrain embed --stale`
- Citation audit: `skills/citation-fixer/SKILL.md`
- Back-link check: `gbrain check-backlinks check`
- Brain lint: `gbrain lint`
- Embedding-model integrity: every `content_chunks.model` must equal the configured `embedding_model` (`voyage:voyage-4`). Any other model (e.g. `zeroentropyai:zembed-1`) = producer regression — stop and audit per [[wiki/systems/embedding-integrity-standard]] (incident: 22k corrupted chunks, Jul 2–8 2026).

## Proactive Surfacing — Medium

Surface uninvited:
- 📌 Overdue items
- ⏰ Items due tomorrow
- ⏰ Items due this week
- ⚠️ Stale Tier-1 relationships (per thresholds in context-memory skill)
- ✅ Notable wins from recent captures
- ⚠️ Notable concerns from recent captures

Do **not** surface uninvited: noise, low-signal reminders, anything not on the list
above.

## Quiet Hours

- Default: 11 PM – 8 AM local time.
- Override: user activity flag (if Steve is active, quiet hours are suspended).
- During quiet hours: save output to held queue, release on first morning contact.
- Exception: genuinely urgent alerts (time-sensitive, would cause real damage).

## Schedule Staggering

Jobs offset by 5-minute intervals to avoid thundering herd:
- :00 — reserved
- :05, :10, :15, :20, :25, :30, :35, :40, :45, :50 — one job per slot
- Max 1 concurrent job per minute
